blocks.text: Buying a Half Duplex or Full Duplex in Pitt Meadows, BC

parts.t: Duplexes in the City of Pitt Meadows are a rare, practical alternative to strata townhomes and detached houses—giving buyers a private fenced yard, driveway parking, and no monthly strata council fees on flat residential streets in Central Meadows and Mid Meadows.

Under City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011, traditional duplexes fall under RD (Two-Unit Residential) zoning, while provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) amendments have expanded duplex and infill opportunities on serviced urban residential lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows Duplexes for Sale

parts.t: Where are duplexes located in Pitt Meadows?
Most half duplexes and full duplexes in Pitt Meadows are located on established residential streets in
Central Meadows
and
Within walking distance of Highland Park Elementary, Pitt Meadows Elementary, and West Coast Express.
Do Pitt Meadows half duplexes have monthly strata fees?

Most Pitt Meadows half duplexes are registered as two-lot strata plans that do not collect monthly strata fees or hold formal council meetings; the two owners simply split the annual building insurance premium and share exterior roof or fence maintenance as needed.
Why are duplex listings scarce in Pitt Meadows?

With 78% of Pitt Meadows land protected inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and a compact urban footprint of roughly 4,800 total dwellings city-wide, duplexes represent a small fraction of housing stock and turn over infrequently.
How does building insurance work on a Pitt Meadows half duplex?

In a two-lot strata duplex under the BC Strata Property Act, the two owners must insure the entire building structure under a joint strata/duplex building policy and carry individual homeowner policies for interior contents, improvements, and personal liability.
Can I build a new duplex on a single-family lot in Pitt Meadows?

City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 and provincial SSMUH zoning updates permit two-unit residential (duplex) construction on qualifying serviced urban lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary, subject to lot width, Flood Construction Levels (FCLs), and parking rules.
Which schools serve duplexes in Central and Mid Meadows?

Depending on the exact street, duplexes in Central and Mid Meadows fall into the catchments for Pitt Meadows Elementary (English & Early French Immersion K-7), Davie Jones Elementary, or Highland Park Elementary, and Pitt Meadows Secondary (Grades 8-12).
